evidence.quote: economic conditions will evolve in a manner that will warrant only gradual increases in the federal funds rate
inflation would likely remain low for somewhat longer than had been previously expected before moving back to 2 percent
more slack may remain in labor market than the unemployment rate alone would suggest
I think there is some benefit to maintaining a larger balance sheet for a time.
If these developments lead to a persistent tightening of financial conditions, they could signal a slowing in the global economy that could affect growth and inflation in the United States.
In my view, a modest overshoot of this sort would be appropriate in current circumstances for two reasons.
